the best (XXXXX) to buy (a) car is a city.

how does one (find) the best XXXXX to buy a car, and how does one (find) the best (XXXXX) to buy an old car?

a:

there are two meanings of the word "best". 

best as in "the best restaurant in town" or "the best hotel".
best in the sense of "best XXXXX but best on a particular day" or "best time to buy at the best shop".

the best restaurant in town won't be the best XXXXX to go as it's a restaurant that's famous for food so it will be the most famous XXXXX to go.
likewise, the best time to buy in the best shop won't be the best XXXXX to shop as the shop isn't that good on a particular day.
